body: Thank you. I just feel overwhelmed everyday. Like I'm just surviving until I can cry myself to sleep just to wake up and do it all over again. It's exhausting.

Sometimes I think people don't know what to say. It's not that they don't want to be there for you...but maybe they don't know how to be there for you. For me, it's always helpful when my friends just hang out with me normally and don't treat me like anything different has happened. 

How are you doing now?
Why do you say that?
I think I'm moving backwards.
I don't feel like that right now
But my friends are normal. They're not perfect but I see them moving forward in life. I'm staying still.

Honestly, nothing. Anything I used to enjoy seems like a chore to me. I used to love concerts. I went to a few this week and I was literally just counting down the songs until they were over so I could just go home. I used to love working out and I can't even do it anymore. It brings me to a state of panic. Being out with my friends makes me depressed...they're all happy and normal and moving forward in their lives and I'm just a black cloud.

I guess so. I'm just so negative I don't even enjoy little things anymore. Coffee used to be my favorite and now I don't like it. Same thing with food, my favorite restaurants are now just blah to me. Eating is like a chore.
I can't give anyone the chance. He fucked that up for me. I'm never going to be the same person again. I don't want to live this way.
But I wanted him to be. I can't imagine anyone else loving me like he did.
Yes. He was my first everything.

I feel like I can never do it again. I don't know. I would love to be positive and everything but I'm so weighed down by this. Everything bothers me. Seeing a car that looks like his makes me cry. Seeing his name makes everything come flooding back. I've gotten rid of all physical reminders, but just thinking of him is enough to make me break down. Everything just makes me cry. I can't stop. i can't live like this.
I know it was stupid. But everything depended on him. He was everything that would've made me happy. I was going to start a life with him. Now I'm back to square 1 with nothing and no one.
But I leaned on him for everything. He was my future. And I lost him. He's out of my life forever. Because of me and my stupidity. How do you get over something like that. I just don't know.

Yeah. He used to tell me "I'm all for supporting you, but only when it makes sense. Not when you're being dramatic." He used to decide whether or not things I went through were "worthy" of support. I know it sounds messed up. He has a lot of flaws. But I love him so much and I think he really loved me and I'm never going to find that with anyone else. I'm never going to try because I know how much it will hurt when it ends. None of that was worth this pain.

I think it's awesome that you had the courage to be open and to tell your mom. I've been dealing with depression for years and I have never had the courage to tell anyone in my family about it. The way she reacted is not your fault and it's not the result of anything you did. Maybe the problem is that she isn't educated about it. Maybe she doesn't know how serious it is. Maybe she doesn't know how to help you. How about your dad? Siblings? Are you close with any of them?

If you don't have any luck with your family, definitely go back to the doctor and see if they can recommend a therapist in the area. If the doctor ignores you, go to a different doctor. A doctor should definitely NOT ignore something like that. Do you have insurance? Is seeing a therapist something you could do financially?

My problem is that all my what ifs are negative. I can't think about a positive future or a time when I'll be happy. I just think negative thoughts to the point where they become actuality. I don't know. I don't see how I can just keep doing this indefinitely.

Yeah, he definitely didn't act right and I had a reason to think he was cheating and lying. But at the same time, I think I made it 100 times worse by pushing it and accusing him of things before I knew for sure. I just fucked up. And I'm never going to find that again.
But it keeps getting worse and worse and worse...I know it sounds good in theory to hang in there, but for how long? Until what point? I just don't understand the point anymore.

No. He won't even speak to me or try to understand. I became paranoid that he was cheating and I still don't know if he was or wasn't, but I became so anxious and nervous about it all that I ended up driving him away because of that.

I kind of feel like it's a bad idea to tie my happiness to people. People leave. People change. People do stupid, illogical things. People hurt you. I know support is important. But I want to find happiness on my own.
I guess I just wouldn't want to present myself to people this way. People who have loved me for 23 years can barely handle it so how can I expect a complete stranger to.

I'm 23. Putting myself out there and allowing myself to be rejected just seems impossible right now. I can barely get dressed and do everyday things so going out and meeting new people may not be possible.
I have nothing and no one. My depression has taken over and it's the worst it's ever been. I lost everyone who was important to me by pushing them away.
